dict.string: Longevity Compass reads your Apple Health data on this device so it can show what most needs your attention. Nothing leaves your iPhone.
Longevity Compass writes blood-pressure readings back to Apple Health so Health remains the single source of truth.
Longevity Compass uses the camera to scan barcodes on packaged foods and to photograph meals for nutrition estimation.
Longevity Compass uses photos of meals to estimate nutrition. Photos are sent to the AI provider you configured in the Data tab.
